title: Servers with repeated backup failures
description: Count failed backups from the last 7 days inclusive (age_days <= 7) for each server_name. Return exactly two columns: server_name, failed_backups, and keep only servers with failed_backups of at least 2. Sort by failed_backups DESC, then server_name ASC for ties.
starter_sql:
SELECT server_name, COUNT(*) AS failed_backups
FROM backups
hints: Old failed backups must not count.
Apply the count threshold after GROUP BY.
solution_explanation: WHERE limits time/status; HAVING keeps servers with repeated failures.
